title: Next.js Front End for LangServe Document Summaries
summary: Jackson Arnold shows a Next.js app that calls LangServe chains to summarize uploaded PDFs.
learn: LangServe sits on FastAPI, so a chain and your own API endpoints share one backend.
A RemoteRunnable on the client lets you invoke a chain or stream its output chunk by chunk.
The PDF is decoded, loaded into documents and passed through a chain with a prompt template.
Next.js authentication was the hardest part, and he plans to move to Firebase.
In the Q&A, the group discusses the Chain of Density prompt, NeMo Guardrails and Presidio for PII.
